QuestInfo.name: Grand Opening: Treasure Hunt
QuestInfo.0: Fantasy Theme World's grand opening event is in progress... \nSpeak to Madame Ming for details.\n
QuestInfo.1: Collect five Treasury Notes from monsters around the theme park to receive a gift.
QuestInfo.2: You found all five of the Treasury Notes in Fantasy Theme World.

0.0: We're holding a wonderful event to celebrate the grand opening of Fantasy Theme World. Won't you be a doll and participate?

yes.0: Oh, splendid! I've hidden 5 Treasury Notes around the park that entitle the holder to one wonderful item from the Fantasy Enterprises treasuries.

no.0: You're more than welcome to leave my park immediately if you're going to be a sourpuss.

1.0: Did you find all five notes?

yes.0: You've really given the park a thorough looking at. Enjoy a little gift.

item.0: Fantasy Theme World is the newest branch in our exciting line of Fantasy amusementoriums! Search every nook and cranny. You wouldn't want to miss the fun.
